# Repository coding assistant instructions

Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) before implementing changes.

**After every completed website modification, publish a Vercel Preview deployment, verify it is READY and renders, and report the real URL.** Never claim publication based only on a local build or screenshot. A failed deploy must be reported transparently, with relevant error details.

Production releases and domain changes require separate authorization. Use pull requests and checks where possible; keep secrets out of Git and browser bundles.

Build accessible, mobile-first interfaces. For AI chat and veterinarian discovery, always distinguish functional backend integrations from demonstrative UI and appointment requests from confirmed bookings.
